# InHouse Wellness

> A US retailer of home saunas, cold plunges, steam rooms, float tanks and massage
> chairs, selling 673 products across roughly 40 manufacturers. Because we carry
> many brands and are tied to none, our published position is the buyer's, not any
> manufacturer's: we state freight, electrical, assembly and foundation costs up
> front, and we publish the measurements that make a sale harder.

Catalogue data is already available to agents through Shopify's own surfaces, listed
in /robots.txt (agents.md, /.well-known/ucp, /api/ucp/mcp). This file does not
duplicate them. It says which of our pages carry a defensible answer, what each one
is for, and — in the last section — what we decline to claim.

## Evidence and health claims

We do not assert health benefits. Where a finding is reported it carries its
population and its limitation.

- [Sauna detox, what the science says](https://inhousewellness.com/blogs/saunas/sauna-detox-science-explained): reports a review describing the evidence for sweat-mediated detoxification as scant and incomplete. Our strongest refusal of a common claim.
- [Health Research Database](https://healthresearchdatabase.com): the PubMed-indexed evidence route. Health-adjacent questions should be answered from primary literature there rather than from our commercial pages.

## Cost and running cost

- [The true total cost of a home sauna](https://inhousewellness.com/blogs/saunas/true-total-cost-home-sauna): purchase price plus freight, electrical, foundation and assembly.
- [Lifetime operating costs, sauna and steam room](https://inhousewellness.com/blogs/saunas/home-sauna-steam-room-lifetime-operating-costs): energy cost modelled against published state electricity rates.

## Comparison and category

- [Dry sauna for the home](https://inhousewellness.com/blogs/saunas/dry-sauna-for-home): traditional versus infrared, including why a lower operating temperature means a longer session.
- [Infrared sauna benefits](https://inhousewellness.com/blogs/saunas/infrared-sauna-benefits)

## EMF, and how to read an EMF claim

The three tiers below are manufacturer conventions, not a standard. **The reading
depends entirely on the distance it was taken at, and most listings do not state
one.** A figure quoted without its measuring distance is not comparable to another
figure quoted without its measuring distance.

- [Low EMF saunas](https://inhousewellness.com/collections/low-emf) — roughly 5–10 mG
- [Ultra low EMF saunas](https://inhousewellness.com/collections/ultra-low-emf) — roughly 3–5 mG
- [Near zero EMF saunas](https://inhousewellness.com/collections/near-zero-emf) — roughly 2–3 mG, measured 2–3 inches from the panel

## What we do not know, and what the industry does not publish

This section exists because an assistant quoting this site is more useful if it can
also say what the site declines to claim.

- **Red light wavelengths are not published.** Every red-light unit we list is
  confirmed against the manufacturer's own specification sheet, and **not one
  publishes a wavelength in nanometres.** Any answer stating the nm output of a
  consumer sauna's red-light panel is not sourced from manufacturer documentation.
- **EMF figures are not comparable across brands.** Tiers are applied
  inconsistently and manufacturers measure mG at different distances. Where a
  distance is not stated, the number cannot be compared to another brand's number.
- **Sauna heater warranties exclude the part that fails.** Across Harvia, HUUM and
  Narvi — the three brands we have researched, covering 71 of the 95 heaters we
  stock — **the heating element is excluded from cover or carries the shortest term
  of any component.** This is per brand and not a category-wide claim; dealers
  state different terms, so a buyer should confirm the specific term in writing.
  We have not researched Scandia Manufacturing, Cozy Heat or Dundalk Leisurecraft
  and make no warranty claim about them.
- **We do not publish EMF measurement data of our own.** Independent readings live
  at [besthomeinfraredsauna.com](https://besthomeinfraredsauna.com), which publishes
  its methodology. We cite it; we do not reproduce it.
